**Checklist**

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass
- [ ] New rules or engine behaviour have tests
- [ ] `docs/rules.md` / `docs/factions.md` updated if rules or faction content changed
- [ ] Balance changes include before/after win rates from `npm run sim`
- [ ] Content is original (no names, art or rules text from other games)
